notes: Albums play in the order you made: starting a song queues the whole album exactly as you arranged it, so a song you moved plays where you put it instead of the old order.
Reorder the songs and the very next tap plays the new order: the album list is read the moment you press play, so the card on screen can never play an arrangement you already replaced.
A song that sits in two albums now keeps open the album you played it from, so the Albums tab stops closing the card in front of you while the song is playing.
The home-screen widget, the lyrics letter wave, the timed lyric lines and the music player are untouched by this release.
Next and Previous follow the same album order as the song that is playing, and a stale tap can no longer push the player past the end of the queue.
Everything else from 73.2 stays: removals stick, emptied albums stay gone, cards collapse on the way out of the Albums tab, and the speed slider is still a regular slider.
